items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: I never realized until later how great it was. I never realized. I thought all these names, you know, and some I didn’t really know well, and later as I collected records I said Jesus, I know this guy. And they just put on a terrific show. Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: Well there’s a big bandstand behind the bar. And standing room, and then booths along the side. And they’d just change every half hour. And everybody’s having a good time. Red Allen was there greeting everybody at the door when they came in, and it was a wonderful time. Really, if you didn’t like the music you had to like it there.
